# stonebranch_universal_template (Resource)

Manages a StoneBranch Universal Template. Universal templates define a reusable custom task type (script-based) that can be executed on Unix/Windows/Any agents via a Universal Agent plugin.

**Deferred fields (not yet supported by this resource):** the `commands` and `events` (event-metric) definitions, and the five top-level per-attribute UI restriction settings (`*FieldsRestriction`). These must be managed outside Terraform (e.g. via the UAC UI) for now.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Stonebranch Universal Template Example
#
# This example demonstrates how to create universal template resources in
# Stonebranch. Universal templates define reusable, script-based custom task
# types that run via a Universal Agent plugin.
#
# Note: this resource models a curated core field set plus the custom UI
# form-builder (`fields`). The `commands`/`events` definitions and the
# top-level per-attribute UI restriction settings are not yet supported and
# must be managed outside Terraform.
#
# Usage:
#   export STONEBRANCH_API_TOKEN="your-token"
#   terraform init
#   terraform plan
#   terraform apply

terraform {
  required_providers {
    stonebranch = {
      source = "stonebranch/stonebranch"
    }
  }
}

provider "stonebranch" {
  # Uses STONEBRANCH_API_TOKEN environment variable
}

# Cross-platform ("Any" agent type) template using a single common script.
resource "stonebranch_universal_template" "health_check" {
  name              = "tf-example-health-check"
  description       = "Runs a health check script on any agent platform"
  variable_prefix   = "HC"
  agent_type        = "Any"
  use_common_script = true
  script            = "curl -sf $HC_URL || exit 1"
  exit_codes        = "0"

  environment = [
    { name = "HC_URL", value = "https://example.com/health" },
  ]
}

# Windows-specific template with platform script and elevated privileges.
resource "stonebranch_universal_template" "windows_cleanup" {
  name            = "tf-example-windows-cleanup"
  description     = "Cleans up temp files on a Windows agent"
  variable_prefix = "WC"
  agent_type      = "Windows"
  script_windows  = "Remove-Item -Path $env:TEMP\\* -Recurse -Force"
  exit_codes      = "0"
  elevate_user    = true
}

# Template exposing a custom UI form ("fields") so operators can fill in
# task-specific values (region, tags, notes) when launching a task built from
# this template. Each field maps to one of a fixed set of typed extension
# slots via `field_mapping` (see the resource documentation for the full
# list of confirmed slot names).
resource "stonebranch_universal_template" "aws_deploy" {
  name              = "tf-example-aws-deploy"
  description       = "Deploys to AWS with operator-supplied region and tags"
  variable_prefix   = "AWS"
  agent_type        = "Any"
  use_common_script = true
  script            = "echo Deploying to $AWS_region with tags $AWS_tags"
  exit_codes        = "0"

  fields = [
    {
      name          = "region"
      label         = "Region"
      field_mapping = "Choice Field 1"
      field_type    = "Choice"
      choices = [
        { field_value = "us-east-1", field_value_label = "US East 1" },
        { field_value = "us-west-2", field_value_label = "US West 2" },
      ]
    },
    {
      name              = "tags"
      label             = "Tags"
      field_mapping     = "Array Field 1"
      field_type        = "Array"
      array_name_title  = "Key"
      array_value_title = "Value"
      array_field_value = [
        { name = "env", value = "prod" },
      ]
    },
    {
      name          = "notes"
      label         = "Notes"
      field_mapping = "Text Field 1"
      field_type    = "Text"
      hint          = "Optional deployment notes"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `agent_type` (String) Agent platform this template targets. Confirmed values: `Windows`, `Any`.
- `exit_codes` (String) Exit codes that indicate success (e.g. '0' or '0,1,2'). The server has no default for this field; it must be set whenever exit_code_processing is a range-based mode (the only modes discovered).
- `name` (String) Unique name of the universal template.
- `variable_prefix` (String) Prefix used for variables exposed by this template (e.g. tasks based on this template expose `<prefix>_<field>` variables).

### Optional

- `agent` (String) Name of the agent to run tasks based on this template.
- `agent_cluster` (String) Name of the agent cluster to run tasks based on this template.
- `agent_cluster_var` (String) Variable containing the agent cluster name.
- `agent_var` (String) Variable containing the agent name.
- `always_cancel_on_finish` (Boolean) Whether to always cancel the task on finish.
- `auto_cleanup` (Boolean) Whether to automatically clean up output artifacts.
- `broadcast_cluster` (String) Name of the broadcast cluster.
- `broadcast_cluster_var` (String) Variable containing the broadcast cluster name.
- `create_console` (Boolean) Whether to create a console window for the task. Windows agent types only.
- `credentials` (String) Name of the credentials to use for task execution.
- `credentials_var` (String) Variable containing the credentials name.
- `description` (String) Description of the universal template.
- `desktop_interact` (Boolean) Whether the task can interact with the desktop. Windows agent types only.
- `elevate_user` (Boolean) Whether to run the task with elevated (administrator) privileges. Windows agent types only.
- `environment` (Attributes List) Environment variables (name/value pairs) passed to the script. Full-replace on update: omitting this attribute clears any previously-set environment variables. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environment))
- `exit_code_output` (String) Output source used for exit code processing when applicable.
- `exit_code_processing` (String) How to process exit codes. Confirmed values: `Success Exitcode Range`, `Failure Exitcode Range`. Default: `Success Exitcode Range`.
- `exit_code_text` (String) Text used for exit code processing when applicable.
- `extension` (String) File extension associated with the template's script.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Custom UI form fields exposed on tasks based on this template. Each field maps to one of a fixed set of typed extension slots on the template via `field_mapping` (e.g. `Text Field 1`..`Text Field 20`, `Integer Field 1`..`Integer Field 10`, `Boolean Field 1`..`Boolean Field 15`, `Choice Field 1`..`Choice Field 15`, `Credential Field 1`..`Credential Field 6`, `Script Field 1`..`Script Field 4`, `Array Field 1`..`Array Field 4`, `Float Field 1`..`Float Field 4`, `Large Text Field 1`..`Large Text Field 4`, `SAP Connection Field 1`, `Database Connection Field 1`). Full-replace on update: omitting this attribute clears any previously-set fields. **Known API limitation:** once a template has fields, the server rejects updates that would reduce the list to empty (`fields = []` or omitting the attribute) — you can only ever replace fields with a different non-empty set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `log_level` (String) Logging level for tasks based on this template. Default: `Inherited`.
- `output_condition_operator` (String) Operator used to evaluate output conditions. Default: `=`.
- `output_condition_strategy` (String) Strategy used to combine output conditions. Default: `Match Any`.
- `output_condition_value` (String) Value used to evaluate output conditions.
- `output_content_type` (String) Content type of the captured output.
- `output_failure_only` (Boolean) Whether to only capture output on failure.
- `output_path_expression` (String) Path expression used to extract output.
- `output_return_file` (String) File to capture output from.
- `output_return_nline` (String) Number of lines to return for output. Default: `100`.
- `output_return_sline` (String) Starting line number for output return. Default: `1`.
- `output_return_text` (String) Text used to filter returned output.
- `output_return_type` (String) How output should be returned. Default: `NONE`.
- `output_type` (String) Type of output to capture. Default: `STDOUT`.
- `runtime_dir` (String) Working directory for the task execution.
- `script` (String) Common script content (used when `use_common_script` is `true`).
- `script_type_windows` (String) Script type/interpreter for the Windows script (e.g. batch, PowerShell). Exact enum values not confirmed empirically.
- `script_unix` (String) Unix/Linux-specific script content.
- `script_windows` (String) Windows-specific script content.
- `send_environment` (String) Controls which environment variables are sent to the agent. Confirmed default: `Launch`.
- `send_variables` (String) Controls which task variables are sent to the agent. Confirmed values: `None`. Default: `None`.
- `template_type` (String) Type of universal template. Confirmed value: `Script`. Other values may exist but were not discovered empirically.
- `use_common_script` (Boolean) Whether to use a single common script (`script`) for all agent types instead of platform-specific scripts (`script_unix`/`script_windows`).
- `wait_for_output` (Boolean) Whether to wait for output before completing.

### Read-Only

- `sys_id` (String) System ID of the universal template (assigned by StoneBranch).

<a id="nestedatt--environment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environment`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the environment variable.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Value of the environment variable.


<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Required:

- `field_mapping` (String) The typed extension slot this field is backed by. Must match `field_type` (e.g. `field_type = "Text"` requires a `Text Field N` or `Large Text Field N` mapping). No server default; always required.
- `label` (String) Display label of the field in the UAC UI.
- `name` (String) Internal name of the field (used in `<variable_prefix>_<name>` task variables).

Optional:

- `allow_variable` (Boolean) Whether the field's value may reference a variable.
- `array_field_value` (Attributes List) For Array-type fields, the default name/value pairs. Full-replace on update. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--array_field_value))
- `array_name_title` (String) For Array-type fields, the column header used for the name/key column.
- `array_value_title` (String) For Array-type fields, the column header used for the value column.
- `boolean_no_value` (String) Custom "false" display value. Required when `boolean_value_type` is `Custom`.
- `boolean_value_type` (String) For Boolean-type fields, how the boolean is represented. Confirmed values: `true/false` (default), `1/0`, `Custom` (requires `boolean_yes_value`/`boolean_no_value` to also be set).
- `boolean_yes_value` (String) Custom "true" display value. Required when `boolean_value_type` is `Custom`.
- `choice_allow_empty` (Boolean) For Choice-type fields, whether an empty selection is allowed.
- `choice_allow_multiple` (Boolean) For Choice-type fields, whether multiple selections are allowed.
- `choice_dynamic` (Boolean) For Choice-type fields, whether choices are populated dynamically (see `choice_fields`) instead of from the static `choices` list.
- `choice_fields` (List of String) For dynamic Choice-type fields, the field names used to populate choices.
- `choice_sort_option` (String) For Choice-type fields, how `choices` are sorted in the UI. Confirmed values: `Sequence` (default), `Label`.
- `choices` (Attributes List) Static choice options for a Choice-type field. Full-replace on update. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--choices))
- `default_list_view` (Boolean) Whether this field is shown by default in list views.
- `extension_status` (Boolean) Whether this field reflects an extension status.
- `field_length` (Number) Maximum length for Text-type fields.
- `field_regex` (String) Regular expression used to validate the field's value.
- `field_restriction` (String) UI restriction applied to this field. Confirmed value: `No Restriction`. Other values may exist but were not discovered empirically. Default: `No Restriction`.
- `field_type` (String) Type of the field. Confirmed values: `Text`, `Integer`, `Boolean`, `Choice`, `Credential`, `Script`, `Array`, `Float`, `SAP Connection`, `Database Connection`. Default: `Text`.
- `field_value` (String) Default value for the field.
- `form_column_span` (Number) Number of form columns this field spans in the UAC UI.
- `form_end_row` (Boolean) Whether this field ends its row in the UAC UI form layout.
- `form_start_row` (Boolean) Whether this field starts a new row in the UAC UI form layout.
- `hint` (String) Help text displayed for the field in the UAC UI.
- `int_field_max` (Number) Maximum value for Integer-type fields.
- `int_field_min` (Number) Minimum value for Integer-type fields.
- `no_space_if_hidden` (Boolean) Whether to remove the field's form space when it is hidden.
- `preserve_output_on_rerun` (Boolean) Whether to preserve the field's output value when the task is rerun.
- `preserve_value_if_hidden` (Boolean) Whether to preserve the field's value when it is hidden.
- `require_if_field` (String) Name of another field whose value conditionally makes this field required (see `require_if_field_value`).
- `require_if_field_value` (String) Value of `require_if_field` that makes this field required.
- `require_if_visible` (Boolean) Whether this field becomes required whenever it is visible.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the field is required. **Known API limitation:** the server silently ignores this attribute (always resets it to `false`) for `field_type` values `Choice`, `Boolean`, and `Array`; it is honored for `Text`, `Integer`, `Credential`, `Script`, `Float`, `SAP Connection`, and `Database Connection`.
- `show_if_field` (String) Name of another field whose value conditionally shows this field (see `show_if_field_value`).
- `show_if_field_value` (String) Value of `show_if_field` that shows this field.
- `text_type` (String) Text formatting for Text-type fields. Confirmed values: `Plain`, `XML`, `JSON`, `YAML`. Default: `Plain`.

<a id="nestedatt--fields--array_field_value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.array_field_value`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name/key of the array entry.

Optional:

- `value` (String) Value of the array entry.


<a id="nestedatt--fields--choices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields.choices`

Required:

- `field_value` (String) The stored value of this choice.

Optional:

- `field_value_label` (String) The display label of this choice.
- `use_field_value_for_label` (Boolean) Whether to display `field_value` instead of `field_value_label` in the UI.
